pr.title: docs(router): archive architecture and audit evidence
pr.body:
## Summary
- preserve the accepted UR-ARCH-001 archive and all 20 extracted deliverables under audit_inputs
- preserve the UR-AUDIT-001R3 archive, extracted audit artifacts, and supervisor adjudication
- add canonical architecture and audit index pages
- register TP-DMX-UR-ARTIFACT-INTAKE-001 and UR-TP-001

## Scope
Evidence and documentation only. No runtime, schema, policy, provider, workflow, or execution behavior changes.

## Validation
Archive hashes, extracted file inventories, task-packet schema validation, pre-commit, diff hygiene, embedded audit, and PR Steward readiness.

steps.task: Lock a clean dedicated worktree at the reviewed main commit and verify the source archives and supervisor adjudication by SHA-256 before any copy.
requirements: The worktree HEAD and origin/main must equal 45b5ee3f320e777111a6f00227072efeb725996b; if main has advanced, stop and refresh this packet against current runtime truth.
The branch must be codex/ur-artifact-intake-001 in a dedicated worktree, not the primary checkout.
No source file may be deleted or modified.
validation: Repo, branch, worktree, base SHA, source inventory, and source hashes are captured in proof before copy.
Any mismatch stops the packet without modifying the repo.

steps.task: Copy the original archives, extract their complete contents without normalization, add the supervisor adjudication, and generate a destination manifest with per-file hashes.
requirements: Preserve exact archive bytes and extracted filenames under audit_inputs/universal_router.
The architecture extraction must contain exactly the 20 required deliverables.
The audit extraction must pass its bundled SHA256SUMS verification.
Reference pages summarize status and point to raw evidence; they must not restate unsupported claims as runtime truth.
validation: Original archive hashes match the accepted hashes.
Every extracted file has a destination SHA-256 entry.
No source archive or Downloads file is deleted.

steps.task: Register both packets in task-packets/INDEX.md and validate both packet JSON files against the current tracked dopetask schema.
requirements: Insert exactly one Active Task Packets row for each packet ID.
Use docs/03-reference/spec/dopetask/dopetask-canonical-spec.json as the current schema authority.
Do not edit packet semantics during staging.
validation: Both JSON packets parse and pass the current tracked task-packet schema.
The index contains no duplicate packet IDs.

steps.task: Capture proof, run diff and docs hygiene checks, run embedded audit, open the PR, and require PR Steward READY at the latest head.
requirements: Embedded audit must be PASS or non-blocking PASS_WITH_RISKS; SKIPPED is blocking.
Use the canonical PR Steward operator surface documented in docs/ops/pr-steward-cli.md.
Only allowlisted paths may be staged.
commands: python -m dopemux.cli pr-steward intake --repo DDD-Enterprises/dopemux-mvp --pr "$PR_NUMBER" --out "proof/TP-DMX-UR-ARTIFACT-INTAKE-001/pr-steward" --strict --proof-path "proof/TP-DMX-UR-ARTIFACT-INTAKE-001/PROOF.json" --format json

python -m dopemux.cli pr-steward gate --head-sha "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" --required-class FINALIZATION --merge-readiness "proof/TP-DMX-UR-ARTIFACT-INTAKE-001/pr-steward/MERGE_READINESS.json" --audit-proof "proof/TP-DMX-UR-ARTIFACT-INTAKE-001/PROOF.json" --format json
validation: Proof is current to the latest PR head SHA.
PR Steward emits readiness=READY and exits 0.
